To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have determined the three-dimensional structure of the mature form of actinohivins, which is the first lectin with a novel β-sandwich fold, in a complex with a high-mannose type glycan of the HIV-1 gp 120 envelope protein.
we have determined the crystal structure of actinohivinis complexed with the α(2-1)-linked manno-biose moiety at a resolution of 1.90Å.
we have successfully crystallized mature AH in a different form from the previously obtained crystals and that the crystallographic analysis has shown that it contains no disorder.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the production of mature AH with high purity and homogeneity.
a crystallographic study of AH and the interaction between AH and the α(1,2)-mannobiose.
the development of a new potent anti- HIV lectin and with the structural study of the lectin and its complex with the α( 1-2) mannobiose moiety.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the crystal structures of AH with and without the α(1,2)mannobiosyl moiety of the HMTG of the HIV-1 gp 120 are now known.
the structure of AH with α(1- 2)mannobiosyl-β-1,2-mannosyl-α-1,2- mannosyl-β- 1,2-mannoheptaose (α(1-2)-Man(3)Gn(2)) attached to the N-termini was determined.
actinohivins are a family of lectins with a common structure, and that they have a high affinity for α(1-3)-mannoside and α(1-6)-mannoside moieties of HMTGs, but not for α(1,2)-mannobiose.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the structure of the complex of mature AH with the α( 1-2) mannobiose moiety is determined to high resolution and the structure of the mature AH itself is determined to 1.90 and 1.70 Å resolutions, respectively, by molecular replacement using the structure of the AH complex with the α(2-6)mannobio-se moiety.
we have obtained a high-quality crystal structure of AH in complex with the HMTG.
the three-dimensional structure of AH was successfully determined with high homogeneity and high quality, and that the crystal structure of AH complexed with HMTG was also determined.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of solubility enhancers such as glycerol and polyethylene glycol is effective for crystallization.
the crystallographic study was successfully performed on a new form of AH that was produced by a simple and efficient procedure.
a new crystal form of AH was obtained that is free of packing disorder, allowing the precise determination of its structure and that of the AH-HMTG complex.
